+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import csv
+import io
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+VERSION = "0.106.1"
+
+
+class NuError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, msg, code="nu::shell::generic_error"):
+        super().__init__(msg)
+        self.msg = msg
+        self.code = code
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Nothing:
+    pass
+
+
+NOTHING = Nothing()
+
+
+def err(text):
+    raise NuError(text)
+
+
+def split_top(s, sep):
+    out, cur = [], []
+    depth = 0
+    q = None
+    esc = False
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(s):
+        c = s[i]
+        if q:
+            cur.append(c)
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif c == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif c == q:
+                q = None
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if c in "'\"`":
+            q = c
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif c in "([{":
+            depth += 1
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif c in ")]}":
+            depth -= 1
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif depth == 0 and s.startswith(sep, i):
+            out.append("".join(cur).strip())
+            cur = []
+            i += len(sep) - 1
+        else:
+            cur.append(c)
+        i += 1
+    out.append("".join(cur).strip())
+    return out
+
+
+def words(s):
+    res, cur = [], []
+    depth = 0
+    q = None
+    esc = False
+    for c in s.strip():
+        if q:
+            cur.append(c)
+            if esc:
+                esc = False
+            elif c == "\\":
+                esc = True
+            elif c == q:
+                q = None
+            continue
+        if c in "'\"`":
+            q = c
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif c in "([{":
+            depth += 1
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif c in ")]}":
+            depth -= 1
+            cur.append(c)
+        elif c.isspace() and depth == 0:
+            if cur:
+                res.append("".join(cur))
+                cur = []
+        else:
+            cur.append(c)
+    if cur:
+        res.append("".join(cur))
+    return res
+
+
+def unquote(s):
+    s = s.strip()
+    if len(s) >= 2 and s[0] == s[-1] and s[0] in "'\"`":
+        body = s[1:-1]
+        if s[0] == "'":
+            return body
+        return bytes(body, "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape").replace("`n", "\n").replace("`t", "\t")
+    return s
+
+
+def parse_number(s):
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+", s):
+        return int(s)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?(\d+\.\d*|\d*\.\d+)([eE][-+]?\d+)?", s) or re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+[eE][-+]?\d+", s):
+        return float(s)
+    return None
+
+
+def bare(s):
+    if s == "true":
+        return True
+    if s == "false":
+        return False
+    if s in ("null", "nothing"):
+        return None
+    n = parse_number(s)
+    if n is not None:
+        return n
+    if len(s) >= 2 and s[0] in "'\"`" and s[-1] == s[0]:
+        return unquote(s)
+    return s
+
+
+def parse_record(s, env):
+    inner = s[1:-1].strip()
+    if not inner:
+        return {}
+    parts = split_top(inner.replace(",", " "), " ")
+    if len(parts) == 1:
+        parts = words(inner.replace(",", " "))
+    out = {}
+    i = 0
+    toks = words(inner.replace(",", " "))
+    while i < len(toks):
+        tok = toks[i]
+        if ":" in tok:
+            k, v = tok.split(":", 1)
+            if v == "":
+                i += 1
+                v = toks[i] if i < len(toks) else ""
+        else:
+            k = tok
+            i += 1
+            v = toks[i] if i < len(toks) else ""
+        out[unquote(k)] = eval_expr(v, env)
+        i += 1
+    return out
+
+
+def parse_list(s, env):
+    inner = s[1:-1].strip()
+    if not inner:
+        return []
+    if ";" in inner:
+        head, *rows = split_top(inner, ";")
+        cols = [unquote(x.strip()) for x in split_top(head.strip()[1:-1] if head.strip().startswith("[") else head, ",")]
+        table = []
+        for r in rows:
+            r = r.strip().strip(",")
+            if r.startswith("[") and r.endswith("]"):
+                vals = [eval_expr(x, env) for x in split_top(r[1:-1], ",")]
+            else:
+                vals = [eval_expr(x, env) for x in words(r.replace(",", " "))]
+            table.append({cols[i]: vals[i] if i < len(vals) else None for i in range(len(cols))})
+        return table
+    parts = split_top(inner, ",") if "," in inner else words(inner)
+    return [eval_expr(p, env) for p in parts if p != ""]
+
+
+def eval_arith(s, env):
+    expr = s
+    expr = re.sub(r"\$env\.([A-Za-z_][\w]*)", lambda m: repr(os.environ.get(m.group(1), "")), expr)
+    expr = re.sub(r"\$([A-Za-z_][\w]*)", lambda m: repr(env.get(m.group(1), "")), expr)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9\s+\-*/%().<>=!&|]+", expr):
+        expr = expr.replace("&&", " and ").replace("||", " or ")
+        try:
+            return eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, {})
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    return None
+
+
+def range_value(s, env):
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(.+?)\.\.(?:(.+?)\.\.)?(.+)", s)
+    if not m:
+        return None
+    start = int(eval_expr(m.group(1), env))
+    if m.group(3) is None:
+        step, end = 1, int(eval_expr(m.group(2), env))
+    elif m.group(2) is None:
+        step, end = 1, int(eval_expr(m.group(3), env))
+    else:
+        step, end = int(eval_expr(m.group(2), env)), int(eval_expr(m.group(3), env))
+    if step == 0:
+        err("step cannot be 0")
+    stop = end + (1 if step > 0 else -1)
+    return list(range(start, stop, step))
+
+
+def eval_expr(s, env=None):
+    env = env or {}
+    s = s.strip()
+    if not s:
+        return NOTHING
+    if s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"):
+        return run_pipeline(s[1:-1], env)
+    if s.startswith("[") and s.endswith("]"):
+        return parse_list(s, env)
+    if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"):
+        return parse_record(s, env)
+    r = range_value(s, env)
+    if r is not None:
+        return r
+    a = eval_arith(s, env)
+    if a is not None:
+        return a
+    if s.startswith("$env."):
+        return os.environ.get(s[5:], "")
+    if s.startswith("$"):
+        return env.get(s[1:], NOTHING)
+    return bare(s)
+
+
+def flatten_numbers(v):
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        out = []
+        for x in v:
+            if isinstance(x, dict):
+                out.extend(y for y in x.values() if isinstance(y, (int, float)))
+            elif isinstance(x, (int, float)):
+                out.append(x)
+        return out
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return [x for x in v.values() if isinstance(x, (int, float))]
+    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+        return [v]
+    return []
+
+
+def get_path(v, path):
+    cur = v
+    for p in path.split("."):
+        if p == "":
+            continue
+        if isinstance(cur, list):
+            if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", p):
+                i = int(p)
+                if i >= len(cur):
+                    raise NuError("index too large", "nu::shell::access_beyond_end")
+                cur = cur[i]
+            else:
+                cur = [get_path(x, p) for x in cur]
+        elif isinstance(cur, dict):
+            if p not in cur:
+                raise NuError(f"Cannot find column '{p}'")
+            cur = cur[p]
+        else:
+            raise NuError("cannot access value")
+    return cur
+
+
+def to_json(v, raw=False, indent=2):
+    if raw:
+        return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, indent=indent)
+
+
+def from_csv_text(text, noheaders=False, sep=","):
+    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(str(text)), delimiter=sep))
+    if not rows:
+        return []
+    if noheaders:
+        return [{f"column{i}": val for i, val in enumerate(row)} for row in rows]
+    headers = rows[0]
+    return [{headers[i]: row[i] if i < len(row) else "" for i in range(len(headers))} for row in rows[1:]]
+
+
+def table_to_csv(v):
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        v = [v]
+    if not isinstance(v, list) or not v:
+        return ""
+    cols = list(v[0].keys()) if isinstance(v[0], dict) else ["value"]
+    buf = io.StringIO()
+    w = csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=cols, lineterminator="\n")
+    w.writeheader()
+    for row in v:
+        w.writerow(row if isinstance(row, dict) else {"value": row})
+    return buf.getvalue().rstrip("\n")
+
+
+def format_value(v):
+    if isinstance(v, Nothing):
+        return ""
+    if v is None:
+        return ""
+    if v is True:
+        return "true"
+    if v is False:
+        return "false"
+    if isinstance(v, float):
+        return str(int(v)) if v.is_integer() else str(v)
+    if isinstance(v, (int, str)):
+        return str(v)
+    if isinstance(v, list):
+        if all(not isinstance(x, (dict, list)) for x in v):
+            return "\n".join(format_value(x) for x in v)
+        return to_json(v)
+    if isinstance(v, dict):
+        return to_json(v)
+    return str(v)
+
+
+def cmd_eval(cmd, inp, env):
+    w = words(cmd)
+    if not w:
+        return inp
+    name = w[0]
+    if name in ("echo", "print"):
+        vals = [eval_expr(x, env) for x in w[1:]]
+        return " ".join(format_value(x) for x in vals)
+    if name == "pwd":
+        return os.getcwd()
+    if name == "ls":
+        path = unquote(w[1]) if len(w) > 1 and not w[1].startswith("-") else "."
+        rows = []
+        for n in sorted(os.listdir(path)):
+            p = os.path.join(path, n)
+            rows.append({"name": os.path.abspath(p), "type": "dir" if os.path.isdir(p) else "file", "size": os.path.getsize(p) if os.path.isfile(p) else 0})
+        return rows
+    if name == "open" and len(w) > 1:
+        with open(unquote(w[1]), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return f.read()
+    if name == "save" and len(w) > 1:
+        with open(unquote(w[-1]), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
+            f.write(format_value(inp))
+        return NOTHING
+    if name == "length":
+        return len(inp) if hasattr(inp, "__len__") else 1
+    if name == "first":
+        n = int(eval_expr(w[1], env)) if len(w) > 1 else 1
+        if isinstance(inp, list):
+            return inp[0] if n == 1 else inp[:n]
+        return inp
+    if name == "last":
+        n = int(eval_expr(w[1], env)) if len(w) > 1 else 1
+        if isinstance(inp, list):
+            return inp[-1] if n == 1 else inp[-n:]
+        return inp
+    if name == "get" and len(w) > 1:
+        return get_path(inp, w[1])
+    if name == "select":
+        cols = w[1:]
+        if isinstance(inp, list):
+            return [{c: get_path(r, c) for c in cols} for r in inp]
+        return {c: get_path(inp, c) for c in cols}
+    if name == "reject":
+        cols = set(w[1:])
+        if isinstance(inp, list):
+            return [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in cols} for r in inp]
+        if isinstance(inp, dict):
+            return {k: v for k, v in inp.items() if k not in cols}
+    if name == "drop" and len(w) > 1 and w[1] == "column":
+        n = int(w[2]) if len(w) > 2 else 1
+        if isinstance(inp, list) and inp and isinstance(inp[0], dict):
+            cols = list(inp[0].keys())[:-n]
+            return [{c: r.get(c) for c in cols} for r in inp]
+    if name == "columns" and isinstance(inp, dict):
+        return list(inp.keys())
+    if name == "values" and isinstance(inp, dict):
+        return list(inp.values())
+    if name == "where" and isinstance(inp, list):
+        cond = cmd[len("where"):].strip()
+        out = []
+        for it in inp:
+            e = dict(env)
+            e["it"] = it
+            test = cond
+            if isinstance(it, dict):
+                for k, v in it.items():
+                    test = re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(k)}\b", repr(v), test)
+            test = test.replace("$it", repr(it))
+            test = re.sub(r"(?<![!<>=])=(?!=)", "==", test)
+            try:
+                if eval(test, {"__builtins__": {}}, {}):
+                    out.append(it)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        return out
+    if name == "sort":
+        key = (lambda x: str(x).lower()) if "-i" in w else None
+        return sorted(inp, key=key) if isinstance(inp, list) else inp
+    if name == "sort-by" and isinstance(inp, list):
+        ci = "-i" in w
+        cols = [x for x in w[1:] if not x.startswith("-")]
+        def k(row):
+            vals = [row.get(c) if isinstance(row, dict) else row for c in cols]
+            return tuple(str(x).lower() if ci else x for x in vals)
+        return sorted(inp, key=k)
+    if name == "math" and len(w) > 1:
+        nums = flatten_numbers(inp)
+        sub = w[1]
+        if sub == "sum":
+            return sum(nums)

+        if sub == "sqrt":

+        if sub == "abs":
+            return abs(nums[0]) if nums else 0
+    if name == "to" and len(w) > 1:
+        if w[1] == "json":
+            raw = "-r" in w or "--raw" in w
+            indent = 2
+            if "--indent" in w:
+                indent = int(w[w.index("--indent") + 1])
+            return to_json(inp, raw, indent)
+        if w[1] == "csv":

+    if name == "from" and len(w) > 1:

+        if w[1] == "csv":

+    if name == "str" and len(w) > 1:

+        sub = w[1]

+        if sub == "downcase":
